title: S4-NEW-15 — Preview stays on the desk.
goal: The Live Preview window opens on the desk with its header controls reachable, stays reachable when its scale grows to 4x (the window keeps itself inside the drawing area), folds, unfolds and closes, and never changes the artwork.

steps.why: After growing, the header is still on the desk and reachable.

cliOnly: dragging the title bar and the resize handle to the workspace edge, and narrowing the browser (tests/production/drawingAndPreviewControls.spec.ts, tests/production/stableStudioGeometry.spec.ts)
